shared_elements: animal or creature shown in profile
horizontal dividing band or register line
arm/hand-like appendages reaching across the surface
justification: Both surfaces divide the field with horizontal register lines and set a row of repeated rectangular/blocky units above or beside profile creatures with limb-like appendages, which is the most specific correspondence. But A is a dense, all-over, deeply undercut and curvilinear composition with no empty ground, while B is sparse, flat, hard-edged and silhouette-like with large blank areas, so the carving manner and overall visual density are markedly different.
